process: Characterization set. Candidate PA12 powder-bed process for caps; machined POM-C guides and aluminum D gauges. Material, machine, lot and postprocessing must be recorded before any physical fit claim.
preconditions: Measure the actual selected switch surrounding dust/actuator geometry before attempting to insert an OD6.4 boss. The custom B cover opening is not a factory compatibility drawing.
Some specimens intentionally have interference against the manufacturer tolerance range. Start with dimensional inspection and do not force a specimen onto hardware.
Record measured, not nominal, specimen dimensions and instrument uncertainty. Do not silently choose the largest clearance as a retained production fit.
D gauges are open-ended process gauges, not axially retained knobs. The mechanical revision supplies a separate set-screw retention candidate.
Printed pin/sleeve pairs do not establish the behavior of machined POM-C or a steel production pin. Test the intended material pair.
